name: cadenway-ops
description: cadenway-ops tooling: 12 cw-ops-* agents (Compose, Traefik, Ansible, Terraform, GitOps agent, secrets, backup, observability and runbook builders plus read-only deployment and security reviewers, plus a .github maintainer), 13 /cw-* commands, 9 path-scoped rules, 17 skills, and the guard, git-guard and format hooks. The plugin root is this .claude/ folder; the hooks only act inside a cadenway-ops checkout.
